items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: They had another cat had a band around there named Ted Williams... He had a band around there. Man, and they got jealous of Bronson... we were blowin' so much.

ctx.x: You mentioned the saxophone players were Albert Walters, Buford Boswell, Lester Young. Who else?
A trumpet player named Ted Williams.
And you were on trumpet, Leonard Phillips.
